method: Synthetic, deterministic; NOT Voyage output. One sha256-seeded axis per signal (+NO_SIGNALS), Gram-Schmidt orthonormalised; embedding = normalise(sum of weighted axes of the signal set), empty set = NO_SIGNALS axis; components rounded to 1e-7. Keys = sha256(signalsText). Covers all 64 subsets of the closed signal set. See src/memory/fixtureVectors.js.
